items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: Boo stayed with me two years. And we kept -- and the son finally come, and we kept him too, Ollie.

ctx.x: Yeah, that's one -- you call him Scotty. And he came over. Bubba Bright -- and Boo was working with them. And Boo sat on the piano and (inaudible) for Christ sakes, she sounded like a man playing the piano. She ain't jiving. So I asked about (inaudible), said "I'd like to bring you to Houston while I'm down there and -- in a rehearsal and test your reading ability, and see if you can handle the book, if you enjoy the book or what." She said (inaudible). Yes. So I sent her a bus ticket to come to Houston. She come…

And they all told her (inaudible). All of them said. "He that. They ain't going to do nothing." You know, "They all say that." And I sent it to her air mail special registered, and she had to sign for it. She stood up for it. And they all in the neighborhood, she says, "I got it, I got it, I got it." (Inaudible).
